Hi, my name's Chris Poole and I'm a crazy cat guy! (and proud of it) … I'm also owned by internet kitties Cole & Marmalade. This channel will be full of clips of the dynamic duo, along with so much more, like vlogs, cat rescue, BIG cat videos, animal welfare vids and reviews.

I hope you enjoy the videos and as always thanks fur watching :)

Contact me: coleandmarmalade@gmail.com
